description:
The Tidal Wave eBike is a step-through frame beach cruiser available in nice array of color options. The step-through frame allows for easier mounting and dismounting, and maybe of use to those riders taking advantage of the electric motor to ease physical disabilities while biking. As such, the Tidal Wave may be the model that is perfect for you. It comes equipped with our standard cross-functional tires, and its motor is a 48V, 750W model featuring a 48V, 12Ah Samsung cell battery which won’t experience memory problems or need to be fully discharged before recharging. (You also don’t have to charge the battery completely when recharging if you don’t have time.) Top speed has been tested to 25 miles per hour, while the maximum range on full electric mode, depending on the weight of the rider, is about 26 miles. The Tidal Wave is a six-speed model for faster travel over longer distances and easier pedaling uphill. The seat has under-springs and a quick release height adjustment. The handlebars are painted alloy, the fork is steel, and the standard beach cruiser tires are 26” x 2.10” beach cruiser rims with metallic spokes. We recommend the standard tires be inflated to 32 PSI (the valve is a 48mm model). The Tidal Wave eBike model weighs approximately 50 lbs (22.7 Kg) without the battery, or 60 lbs with the battery. When your product ships to you, you will receive your new Wave eBike partially assembled, so professional assembly is required.

The Tidal Wave’s throttle is a 3-Level cadence sensor with pedal assist. You can pedal manually, use the assist, or ride on full electric. The maximum recommended weight limit for riders is 270 pounds. As for rider size, while we don’t stipulate absolute minimums or maximums, the seat adjusts to allow for riders between 4’10” and 6’2″. The seat extends 8 inches, which puts the seat 41 inches above the ground. The minimum seat height is 33 inches from the ground.
